_comment: Registry of Supabase DB lint codes monitored by CI. Add an entry here AND a count in lint-baseline.json to start tracking a new code. `name` must match the linter's `name` field (the code without the leading numeric prefix).

codes.name: pg_graphql_authenticated_table_exposed
codes.label: GraphQL exposure (authenticated)
codes.description: Table or view is discoverable via pg_graphql to the `authenticated` role.

codes.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
codes.label: SECURITY DEFINER function executable by authenticated
codes.description: SECURITY DEFINER function is EXECUTE-able by the `authenticated` role.
